verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a CLI/registry for packaging and installing agent 'skills' (SKILL.md prompt/resource bundles) across coding agents; it has no evidence of issuing or scoping API credentials, keys, or tokens for agents. The 'allowed-tools' frontmatter field only pre-approves which tools a skill may invoke, not credential issuance, so this axis is a category mismatch for the product.
